(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (!= (at g r c) 0))
                           (list r c (at g r c))))
                  (max-r (max-of first cells))
                  (new-cells (for/list ((cell cells))
                               (let* ((cr (first cell))
                                      (cc (second cell))
                                      (cv (third cell))
                                      (new-c (- cc (- max-r cr))))
                                 (list cr new-c cv))))
                  (pos-map (make-hash)))
             (for ((nc new-cells))
               (let ((nr (first nc))
                     (nnc (second nc))
                     (nv (third nc)))
                 (when
                   (and (>= nnc 0) (< nnc w) (>= nr 0) (< nr h))
                   (hash-set! pos-map (list nr nnc) nv))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((hash-has-key? pos-map (list r c)) (hash-ref pos-map (list r c)))
                        (else 0)))))))
